tools.name: onfleet_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks created or completed in a time range. Returns up to 64 tasks per page; pass the returned lastId as lastId to get the next page. Onfleet API: GET /tasks/all.

tools.name: onfleet_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by its ID, with its state, destination, recipients and completion details. Onfleet API: GET /tasks/{taskId}.

tools.name: onfleet_get_task_by_short_id
tools.description: Get one task by its short ID (the 8-character code shown in the Onfleet dashboard). Onfleet API: GET /tasks/shortId/{shortId}.

tools.name: onfleet_get_order
tools.description: Get one delivery order (a pickup task and its dropoff task) by its short ID. Onfleet API: GET /taskOrders/{orderShortId}.

tools.name: onfleet_list_route_plans
tools.description: List route plans, optionally for one worker. Onfleet API: GET /routePlans.

tools.name: onfleet_get_route_plan
tools.description: Get one route plan by its ID. Onfleet API: GET /routePlans/{routePlanId}.

tools.name: onfleet_get_delivery_manifest
tools.description: Generate the compliance delivery manifest for the tasks on one worker's route at one hub. Onfleet API: GET /integrations/manifest/generate.

tools.name: onfleet_create_destination
tools.description: Create a delivery destination from an address. Onfleet geocodes the address when no location is given. Returns the destination ID for onfleet_create_task. Onfleet API: POST /destinations.

tools.name: onfleet_create_worker
tools.description: Create a driver (worker) that belongs to one or more teams. Onfleet API: POST /workers.

tools.name: onfleet_create_task
tools.description: Create a delivery task for an existing destination. Recipients may get SMS notifications unless skipped. Create the destination first with onfleet_create_destination. Onfleet API: POST /tasks.

tools.name: onfleet_cancel_orders
tools.description: Cancel delivery orders before they complete. Completed orders cannot be cancelled. Onfleet API: POST /taskOrders/cancel.

tools.name: onfleet_delete_route_plan
tools.description: Delete a route plan. This cannot be undone. Onfleet API: DELETE /routePlans/{routePlanId}.

tools.name: onfleet_update_webhook
tools.description: Replace a webhook's settings: its receiving URL, trigger and options. Onfleet API: PUT /webhooks/{webhookId}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: onfleet_create_task · Public sink: onfleet_create_destination, onfleet_create_worker, onfleet_create_task, onfleet_cancel_orders, onfleet_update_webhook · Destructive: onfleet_delete_route_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: onfleet_create_task · Public sink: onfleet_create_destination, onfleet_create_worker, onfleet_create_task, onfleet_cancel_orders, onfleet_update_webhook · Destructive: onfleet_delete_route_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
